csv_project_name: Db Svc for 1600 Amp Automatic Transfer Switch Install
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Gulf Breeze, Florida, is issuing a Request for Qualifications (RFQ) to qualified professional engineering firms licensed in the State of Florida to identify and select the most qualified design-build team consisting of a licensed electrical contractor and a Florida-licensed Professional Engineer. The selected team shall be responsible for the complete design, permitting, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning, training, and project closeout associated with the installation of a new 1600 Amp Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) system and exterior quick-disconnect generator connection at the Community Center located at 800 Shoreline Drive, Gulf Breeze, Florida.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Construction/Project Management, Mechanical Engineering
